title: Realization Divergence in Multi-Provider Quantum Computing: A Pre-Registered Study of What Survives Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2610.21714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum programs pass through compilers, transpilers and vendor services before execution. However, the distance between what was written and what runs is rarely measured. We call this distance realization divergence: the observable difference in how an identical source circuit is realized and behaves across quantum software stacks. We report a hardware study across three vendors and four devices, combining pre-registered predictions with explicitly identified exploratory analyses and amendments. In a compilation experiment with assigned placement policies, embedding radius correlates with two-qubit overhead at Spearman 0.805, against 0.492 for circuit size. Under a fixed lowest-index policy, an eight-qubit Bernstein-Vazirani circuit exhibits greater execution divergence than a twelve-qubit circuit on IQM Emerald. The opposite ordering occurs on IQM Garnet. Both comparisons replicate across two repetitions with disjoint confidence interv

translated_title: 多供应商量子计算中的实现分歧：一项关于测量结果幸存内容的预注册研究
translated_abstract: 量子程序在执行前需要经过编译器、转译器和供应商服务的处理。然而，所编写的程序与实际运行内容之间的差距却很少被测量。我们将这一差距称为“实现分歧”：即同一源电路在不同量子软件栈中被实现和运行时所表现出的可观测差异。我们报告了一项覆盖三家供应商、四台设备的硬件研究，将预注册的预测与明确标识的探索性分析及修正相结合。在一项采用指定放置策略的编译实验中，嵌入半径与双量子比特开销的 Spearman 相关系数达到 0.805，而电路规模仅为 0.492。在固定的最低索引放置策略下，一个八量子比特的 Bernstein-Vazirani 电路在 IQM Emerald 上表现出的执行分歧大于十二量子比特电路，而在 IQM Garnet 上则出现相反的排序。两项比较均在两次重复实验中得到复现，且置信区间互不重叠。
tldr: 该研究提出“实现分歧”概念来量化同一量子电路在不同供应商软件栈中的实现差异，并通过覆盖三家供应商、四台设备的预注册硬件研究发现，嵌入半径比电路规模更能预测双量子比特开销，且电路规模与执行分歧的排序在不同设备上可能完全相反。
en_tdlr: This pre-registered multi-vendor hardware study introduces "realization divergence" to quantify how identical quantum circuits differ across software stacks, finding that embedding radius predicts two-qubit overhead better than circuit size (Spearman 0.805 vs 0.492) and that execution-divergence orderings by circuit size can reverse across devices.
